claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Benproperine at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, since its reported anticancer activity is anti-migratory/anti-metastatic via ARPC2 inhibition and autophagy arrest rather than direct killing, and no killing pattern is expected at this concentration.
